title: Curb cuts.
officialText:
The lowering of any curb or the change of grade of any sidewalk for the purpose of providing a driveway across such curb or sidewalk shall be constructed in accordance with the specifications prescribed in Sections 406.7.6 and 406.7.7. All sidewalks and driveways or portions thereof that are structurally supported shall be designed for loads prescribed in
Chapter 16.
